cuisinetwist

The Story

I love cooking and creating new creative dishes, seeing how I can mix and match what I already have in my pantry with dishes from different cuisines. I created cuisinetwist as a recipe creative partner, allowing me to re-imagine what I can make while exploring a new culture.

cuisinetwist offers a few capabilities:

  • Generate an interesting recipe off of a dish type, a main, and a cuisine twist
  • Allow the user to save up to 7 dishes for their weekly meal plan
  • Manage grocery list based off of the recipes and can be shared with others
  • Manage what's in your pantry, prioritizing the items for recipe generation
  • Offers handy information while cooking, such as ingredient substitutions, recipe measurements and comparisons, and course control suggestions for each cuisine type

I built this with Claude Code, using the Claude API for recipe generation. The design started in Canva, then refined in Figma and Claude Design. It runs on a React stack, deployed on Vercel, with all user data stored in local storage.

About me

Hi, I'm Christine, a payments and fintech PM with 9 years of experience building products across digital wallets at Mastercard, driver payouts at Uber, neobanking and remittance lending at Remitly, and BNPL card issuing at Zip.

I've worked across global and emerging markets, which has helped me better understand the role of money movement in different cultures. I'm also passionate about financial inclusion and building products for underserved communities, and am currently staying close to where fintech is headed with blockchain and agents.

In my free time, I've worked on side projects using AI tools and enjoy organizing in-person experiences around education, wellness, and community building. You can find more on my personal website.

I'm currently open to new opportunities and would love to connect!
